info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Organization Realms API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: realmId
params.description: The unique identifier of the realm to update.</br>**Example:** `website-domain-coveo.com`

items.docs:
Updates a realm of an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"GROUP","type":"EDIT","targetId":"*"} ```
